checks.detail: A trusted measurement report is required.
A trusted measurement report is required.
A trusted measurement report is required.
Every trial must remain within three searches and three case-scoped sources.
Every returned claim requires an exact quote from its numbered source.
Supported, refined and unsupported questions must meet the predefined measurement criteria; counters alone do not pass.
Human review of entailment, relevance and representative questions remains required.
All offered, submitted, successful, failed and dropped requests must be accounted for; rejections are not hidden.
Measured latency scope is checked separately from model quality and service acceptance.
Random-weight timing benchmarks cannot qualify a model candidate for release.
Observed held-out quality must meet the recorded laboratory threshold without split overlap.
Synthetic classification and sequential timings do not accept real object detection, peak load or a service latency target.
Successful execution is required but does not prove a useful explanation.
SHAP numerical reconstruction is checked; additivity does not prove causality or suitability.
Out-of-range or inaccurate local surrogate output blocks a reliable-explanation claim; no clipping is accepted.
SHAP numerical reconstruction is checked; additivity does not prove causality or suitability.
Domain experts must review explanation usefulness, stability, perturbations and limitations.
A separate authorized human approval has not been recorded by this evaluator.

limitations: The caller must supply trusted measurement reports; this is not a signature or source-authenticity verifier.
Completeness, independence and representativeness of the supplied evidence are not established here.
Technical-candidate status concerns this laboratory evidence only and is not permission to deploy.
No human approval, model registry release, production capacity, compliance or business acceptance is performed.
